name: patent-review
summary: 专利技术交底书多轮循环严格审查。支持多维审查（数据流闭合、术语一致、状态迁移、公式完整、错误代码分流、图文一致性（集成drawio-skill））、逐轮收敛、可选自动修复（默认关闭需人工确认）。
runtime_requirements: Run this skill after patent disclosure drafts (.md) are complete and before Word export.
For multi-document review, pass all related disclosures as input.
Default mode is review-only (dry-run); auto-fix requires explicit --fix flag and per-issue confirmation for severe issues.
Enable `diagram-consistency` feature when .drawio or .xml diagram files are available alongside the disclosure.
post_install_hints: Invoke with /patent-review or via Skill tool. Pass patent disclosure markdown file paths as input.
Use --fix to enable auto-repair mode, but severe issues will still require human confirmation.
For cross-document interface checks, pass all related disclosures together.
For text-diagram consistency (D7), pass .drawio files alongside the patent .md files. The drawio-skill will auto-parse them.
